title: Gemini: a week of
on-brand posts
in one sitting.
slides.subtitle: Black Friday is Friday. Prompts included.

slides.label: Why bother
slides.detail: 76% of UK small business owners and tradespeople make or edit social posts every week, and 54% spend one to three hours on it (Markel Direct, 501 owners).
slides.start: Black Friday week is when that time is scarcest.

slides.label: Step 1: Open the business page
slides.detail: Google is rolling out a business page inside the Gemini app, with brand, finances and customer insights in one place. Update the app and look for it in the menu.
slides.start: Not there yet? Every prompt here still works in a normal chat.

slides.label: Step 2: Save your brand style once
slides.detail: Upload your logo, colours and fonts, or a clean brand sheet. A website alone can pull in old banners and colours. Gemini keeps the style for later images.
slides.start: Name the style after your business so it is easy to call up.

slides.label: Step 3: Plan the week
slides.detail: Paste this, with your details filled in:
slides.start: Edit the plan before you make a single image.
slides.quote: Plan 5 posts for [business] for Black Friday week, Monday to Friday. Our offer: [offer, price, dates]. For each: a hook line, a caption under 60 words, one image idea in our brand style. No prices I have not given you. Ask me anything you are unsure of first.

slides.label: Step 4: Make the images
slides.detail: Paste: Make the image for post 1 in our saved brand style, square, with clear space at the top for text. Then post 2, and so on.
slides.start: Put prices and dates in as real text afterwards, not in the picture.

slides.label: Step 5: Schedule it all
slides.detail: Load the five posts into your scheduler, or Meta Business Suite for Facebook and Instagram, in one go. Add the offer to your Google Business Profile as well.
slides.start: Then the week runs itself while you serve customers.

slides.label: What it could give back
slides.detail: If posting eats two hours across a normal week and one 30 minute sitting covers it, that is about an hour and a half back each week, roughly 70 hours a year. Illustrative, so time your own.
slides.start: The bigger win: posts that all look like you.

slides.label: One thing to watch
slides.detail: AI images can mangle small text and logos, and captions can invent details. Check every price against your till before anything goes out. Free accounts may get a different image model.
